name: GA-14
label: Safe R

key_factors: Harris outraised Fuller heavily but spent it all
model.rationale: The district's R+19 lean and Fuller's incumbency make this safely Republican despite Harris's large fundraising, which left him with almost no cash on hand. Markets price Harris near 5%, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: A late surge of Harris outside spending or a scandal involving Fuller could narrow the race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Northwest Georgia's 14th District is deeply Republican, with a partisan lean of R+19, and incumbent Clay Fuller is running after easily securing renomination. Fuller has raised about $1.8 million with substantial outside support, though he holds limited cash on hand. Challenger Shawn Harris has outraised him by a wide margin, roughly $8.1 million, but reports almost nothing left in the bank, and outside groups have spent against him. Prediction markets give Harris only about a 5% chance of winning. No public polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and spending patterns. The seat remains safely in Republican hands, with Harris needing an exceptional environment to compete.
